description: This file defines asynchronous flow functions for managing notes and tags, including creating, updating, deleting, retrieving, and listing notes with associated tags. It acts as a business logic layer interfacing with the notes repository and logging operations.

methods.name: tuple[notes_repo.NoteRow,list[notes_repo.TagRow]] create_note_flow( session: AsyncSession, *, title: str, content: str, is_archived: bool, tag_ids: list[UUID], tag_names: list[str], )
methods.description: Creates a new note with provided details, ensures tags by name, attaches tags, and returns the created note and associated tags.

methods.name: tuple[notes_repo.NoteRow,list[notes_repo.TagRow]] update_note_flow( session: AsyncSession, *, note_id: UUID, title: str | None, content: str | None, is_archived: bool | None, tag_ids: list[UUID] | None, tag_names: list[str] | None, )
methods.description: Updates an existing note with optional new details and tags, replacing existing tags if specified, and returns the updated note and tags.

methods.name: None delete_note_flow(session: AsyncSession, *, note_id: UUID)
methods.description: Deletes a note identified by note_id.

methods.name: tuple[notes_repo.NoteRow,list[notes_repo.TagRow]] get_note_flow(session: AsyncSession, *, note_id: UUID)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note along with its tags based on note_id.

methods.name: tuple[list[notes_repo.NoteRow],dict[UUID,list[notes_repo.TagRow]],int] list_notes_flow( session: AsyncSession, *, q: str | None, tag_id: UUID | None, include_archived: bool, limit: int, offset: int, )
methods.description: Lists notes filtered by query, tags, archival status, with pagination support, returning notes, tags grouped by note, and total count.
